title: Preorder Vehicles Get Ekho's Fast Checkout
summary: Preorder vehicles ordered directly from the manufacturer now run through the same fast, guided checkout as inventory already on the lot, including real multi-location pickup. It's rolling out across dealers over the coming weeks.
body_markdown:
AI summary


Preorder vehicles ordered directly from the manufacturer now run through the same fast, guided checkout as inventory already on the lot, including real multi-location pickup. It's rolling out across dealers over the coming weeks.


Until now, a buyer configuring a preorder vehicle, one ordered directly from the manufacturer rather than pulled from the lot, moved through a slower path than a buyer picking something already in stock. That gap is closing.


##


What changed


Preorder vehicles now run through the same fast, guided checkout as titled inventory already on the lot. A buyer sees the same steps, the same running total, and the same clarity about what happens next, whichever kind of vehicle they're buying.


##


More of your catalog, one flow


Any vehicle a dealer can offer as a preorder now sells through the same flow as what is already sitting on the lot, rather than a separate, slower process. A buyer never has to know which one they picked.


##


Pick up where it's convenient


When a preorder vehicle has more than one pickup point, buyers now choose from real locations, sorted by distance, instead of a single generic option.


##


Rolling out now


This is rolling out across dealers over the coming weeks, so not every storefront has it live yet.


##


Where to find it


On a participating dealer's site, open a preorder vehicle's listing and start checkout.


## Frequently asked questions


A vehicle ordered directly from the manufacturer rather than sold from a dealer's existing lot.


It's rolling out across dealers over the coming weeks.
